description: A domestic electricity bill issued by an Indian state distribution company.

consumer_name.description: Name of the account holder, printed near the top of the bill above the supply address.

consumer_number.description: The consumer or service connection number, usually a long digit string in the header block. Keep it as text so leading zeros survive.

bill_number.description: The bill or invoice number for this billing cycle.

billing_period.description: The period this bill covers, printed as a from and to date pair.

bill_date.description: The date the bill was issued, as printed on the document.

due_date.description: The last date for payment without a late fee, as printed on the document.

meter_number.description: The meter serial number shown in the reading section.

previous_reading.description: The previous meter reading in units, from the reading section.

current_reading.description: The current meter reading in units, from the reading section.

units_consumed.description: Total units billed for this period, in kWh.

sanctioned_load_kw.description: The sanctioned load for the connection, in kilowatts.

connection_type.description: The tariff category of the connection as printed on the bill.

payment_status.description: Whether the bill shows as settled or still outstanding.

total_amount.description: The net amount payable by the due date, in rupees.

arrears_amount.description: Any unpaid amount carried forward from earlier bills, in rupees.

supply_address.description: The address of the premises the connection supplies, as printed under the consumer name.

line1.description: House or door number and street, the first line of the printed address.

locality.description: Locality, village or area name from the printed address.

district.description: District or city name from the printed address.

state.description: State name from the printed address.

pin_code.description: Six digit postal code. Keep it as text so leading zeros survive.

tariff_slabs.description: One entry per slab row in the energy charge breakdown table.

items.description: A single slab row from the energy charge table.

slab_label.description: The unit range this row covers, exactly as printed in the first column.

rate_per_unit.description: Rate charged per unit in this slab, in rupees.

amount.description: Amount charged for this slab row, in rupees.

other_charges.description: One entry per line in the charges and adjustments table below the energy charges.

items.description: A single charge or adjustment line.

label.description: The charge description exactly as printed, for example fixed charge or electricity duty.

amount.description: The amount of this charge in rupees. Negative when the line is a rebate.
